verdict.rationale: No evidence pack items address telemetry/usage-tracking opt-out settings for BugSnag itself (e.g., product analytics, MCP server telemetry, CLI telemetry); event-usage docs discuss error event quotas, not tracking opt-out. Missing for 10: any documentation of a telemetry/usage-data opt-out mechanism, privacy settings, or statements about what usage data BugSnag collects from its own tools.
